name: InterContinental Hotels Group
description: IHG is a hotel franchisor and manager with 6,963 hotels and 1,026,177 rooms in its system at the end of 2025 under brands including Holiday Inn Express, Holiday Inn, Crowne Plaza, InterContinental, Kimpton, Hotel Indigo, voco, Staybridge Suites and Candlewood Suites; 73% of rooms are franchised, 27% managed and only 17 hotels are owned or leased. It earns fees as a percentage of hotel revenue (and profit, for managed hotels), which produced $1.23 billion of operating profit in 2025, 97% of the segment total. Reported revenue of $5.2 billion is more than half pass-through: $2.7 billion is System Fund (marketing, loyalty and reservations) and reimbursable revenues that are spent on behalf of hotel owners. It returns cash steadily: dividends of 184.5 cents per share for 2025 and a $950 million buyback in 2026.

sub.name: Hotels, resorts, theme parks and live events

hq.note: 1 Windsor Dials, Arthur Road, Windsor (FY2025 20-F cover); incorporated in England and Wales

employees.note: 7,459 employees whose costs IHG bears plus 20,390 whose costs are borne by the System Fund or reimbursed (FY2025 20-F note on staff costs)

businessLines.name: Americas
businessLines.how: Franchisees pay a fee on room revenue and managed-hotel owners pay base and incentive fees to use the brands, reservation system and IHG One Rewards; IHG invests little of its own money in the hotels.
businessLines.description: 4,603 hotels, 529,194 rooms at 2025 year end (51.6% of system rooms); pipeline 1,067 hotels (105,374 rooms). Brand mix by region not read.

operatingProfit.note: Operating profit from reportable segments; FY2024 $828M; FY2023 $815M. Margin on segment revenue computed by the scout.

businessLines.name: EMEAA (Europe, Middle East, Asia and Africa)
businessLines.how: Same fee model as the Americas (fees on hotel revenue, and on profit for managed hotels); the margin is lower than the Americas (37% vs 74%), reason not stated in the sections read.
businessLines.description: 1,478 hotels, 287,602 rooms at 2025 year end (28.0% of system rooms); pipeline 643 hotels (116,866 rooms).

operatingProfit.note: Operating profit from reportable segments; FY2024 $270M; FY2023 $215M. Margin computed by the scout.

businessLines.name: Greater China
businessLines.how: Fees on franchised and managed hotels in Greater China; operating profit is about 60% of segment revenue.
businessLines.description: 882 hotels, 209,381 rooms at 2025 year end (20.4% of system rooms); pipeline 582 hotels (117,286 rooms).

operatingProfit.note: Operating profit from reportable segments; FY2024 $98M; FY2023 $96M. Margin computed by the scout.

businessLines.name: Central
businessLines.how: Net of IHG's global central costs and fee items booked outside the regions; the sections read do not itemise it.
businessLines.description: Global functions and items not allocated to regions; the segment table shows insurance activities of $(9)M inside segment profit. Other content of the line not read.

operatingProfit.note: FY2024 $(72)M; FY2023 $(107)M. The swing to a profit was the largest single driver (+$99M) of the +$141M rise in segment profit.

businessLines.name: System Fund and reimbursable revenues
businessLines.how: Hotels contribute a percentage of room revenue to a central fund and IHG spends it on brand marketing, loyalty and distribution for the owners, earning little itself.
businessLines.description: Money hotels pay into the System Fund (marketing, IHG One Rewards loyalty program and the reservation system) and costs IHG recharges to owners, mainly payroll at managed hotels.

operatingProfit.note: System Fund and reimbursable result; FY2024 $(83)M; FY2023 +$19M. It is meant to run at about break-even over time.
